ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Calculate the amount of current through the zener diode under no-load conditions in the regulated power supply circuit, as shown in the figure. The current through the zener diode is ______ mA.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a regulated power supply circuit. On the left is a transformer labeled 120/18, and the secondary is connected to a bridge rectifier; after bridge rectification, a 1000 µF filter capacitor is connected in parallel. The filtered DC voltage is sent through a series resistor labeled 2.2 kΩ to a Zener diode branch labeled 9.3 V, and is connected to the transistor regulated output part on the right. There is also a 47 µF capacitor beside the output terminal, and the terminals are labeled -V and Gnd. Then reason: Under no-load conditions, according to the method given in the problem, ignore the output load current and transistor current, so all the current through the 2.2 kΩ resistor is regarded as the Zener diode current. The transformer secondary is 18 V rms; after bridge rectification and capacitor filtering, it is approximately the peak voltage minus the voltage drops of two conducting diodes: V_DC ≈ 18√2 - 2(0.7) ≈ 25.46 - 1.4 = 24.06 V. The voltage across the series resistor is V_R = 24.06 - 9.3 = 14.76 V. Therefore the Zener current I_Z = V_R / R = 14.76 / 2200 ≈ 0.00671 A = 6.7 mA.

raw_record.question_text: Calculate the amount of current through the zener diode under no-load conditions in the regulated power supply circuit, as shown in the figure. The current through the zener diode is ______ mA.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit in the image: the 18 VAC transformer secondary is bridge-rectified, filtered by the 1000 µF capacitor, then feeds a 2.2 kΩ resistor into a 9.3 V zener shunt reference. From the text, impose no-load conditions, so ignore output load/transistor current and treat all resistor current as zener current. Compute the filtered supply as the AC peak after the bridge drops, subtract the zener voltage across the resistor, and divide by 2.2 kΩ to obtain about 6.7 mA.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个稳压电源电路。左侧为标注 120/18 的变压器，次级接到桥式整流器；桥式整流后并联一个 1000 µF 滤波电容。滤波后的直流电压经一个标注 2.2 kΩ 的串联电阻送到一个标注 9.3 V 的齐纳二极管支路，并与右侧晶体管稳压输出部分相连，输出端旁还有 47 µF 电容，端子标为 -V 和 Gnd。

再推理：无负载条件下，按题设方法忽略输出负载电流和晶体管电流，因此通过 2.2 kΩ 电阻的电流全部视为齐纳二极管电流。变压器次级为 18 V rms，经桥式整流和电容滤波后近似为峰值电压减去两个导通二极管压降：V_DC ≈ 18√2 - 2(0.7) ≈ 25.46 - 1.4 = 24.06 V。串联电阻两端电压为 V_R = 24.06 - 9.3 = 14.76 V。因此齐纳电流 I_Z = V_R / R = 14.76 / 2200 ≈ 0.00671 A = 6.7 mA。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct circuit-equivalent route: identify the rectified and filtered DC level from the transformer secondary, then use the series resistor voltage drop to get the no-load zener current.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the circuit values and structure from the diagram: a 120/18 transformer feeding a bridge rectifier and 1000 µF smoothing capacitor; a 2.2 kΩ resistor from the rectified DC node to a 9.3 V zener diode connected to ground; the output transistor/load branch is present but the question states no-load conditions.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question’s requirement to calculate the zener diode current specifically under no-load conditions, and report the result in mA.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use full-wave bridge rectifier filtering: the capacitor charges approximately to the secondary peak voltage minus two conducting diode drops, so V_DC ≈ 18√2 − 2(0.7) V. Under no load, transistor/base load current is negligible, so the current through the 2.2 kΩ resistor equals the zener current. Apply Ohm’s law: I_Z = (V_DC − V_Z)/R = (18√2 − 1.4 − 9.3)/2200 ≈ 0.0067 A = 6.7 mA.
